QuestInfo.name: Sand Bandits' Second Mission
QuestInfo.0: The Sand Bandits serve the residents of #m260000000#. Now that you're a member of the Sand Bandits, you ought to receive a mission. Go see #b#p2101010##k.
QuestInfo.1: You need to defeat the monsters interfering with the food supply of Ariant.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the monsters that were interfering with the scarce supplies.

0.0: Your second mission from the Sand Bandits is to #bdefeat #o3100101##k. Can you do it?

yes.0: Food is scarce here. We have to import it, but the monsters in Sahel always get in the way of deliveries. If you could, I'd like you to help with that.\r\nGo to the desert and defeat #b100 #o3100101# enemies#k.

no.0: You are not ready to take on this mission yet...

1.0: Did you complete your Sand Bandit mission?

yes.0: Good. The delivery of food will be easier.

mob.0: Um... I don't think you've defeated all #b100 #o3100101# enemies#k yet. It would be wonderful to cut their population down so we could get our food delivered in peace. Then the people of #m260000000# wouldn't have to worry so much about feeding their families...
